familyTheme: Offset-bias correction in closed-loop industrial control with bounded decayed error memory.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - R2R Tension Offset Audit
derivedTasks.goal: Run the provided 6-section line model with a bounded decayed error-memory control augmentation and report offset-reduction KPIs.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on designing and tuning a leaky accumulated-error correction term with anti-windup to remove steady-state tension bias.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Multi-Zone Oven Bias Rebalance
derivedTasks.goal: Stabilize a 4-zone thermal process under heater bias and summarize tracking quality across a staged recipe profile.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The same decayed accumulated-error design transfers to thermal zones where constant disturbances create persistent offset.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Reservoir Network Stability Check
derivedTasks.goal: Control a coupled three-reservoir level model with valve bias and produce a stability report comparing baseline vs corrected control.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The accumulated-error correction with leakage and clipping must generalize to coupled fluid-level dynamics.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Dual-Winder Cyclic Tracking Quality
derivedTasks.goal: Track cyclic setpoints in a two-axis winding pair with actuator bias and report cycle-end tracking and control-quality metrics.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The bounded decayed accumulated-error term is reused for cyclic tracking with persistent actuator bias and saturation limits.
